paragraphs: Psyrin sells Mira, which its product page calls an AI voice agent that runs the pre-assessment, scribes the session, and lands structured notes in the clinic EHR. Clients reach Mira by phone or at a kiosk in the clinic, and the clinician walks into a session the agent has already begun. The stated gain is time, with the DA and first ITP completed in 30 minutes rather than the 120 minutes the pages describe.

The buyers these pages name are behavioral health clinics, with homepage testimonials attributed to a CCBHC, a Behavioral Health Clinic and a Private Addiction Center. Notes are generated in the Psyrin platform and pushed to CareLogic, SmartCare, or a custom EHR through RPA or API, with no manual re-entry. Risk disclosed during pre-assessment is routed to a person, with Mira flagging it and starting a warm handover to a clinician on the team.

Beyond the workflow, the pages describe voice biomarkers, where the platform analyses speech patterns during clinical sessions with consent. The kiosk is described as running the full pre-assessment and keeping the client seated for the session over integrated telehealth.

quote.text: The intelligence layer for psychiatry. Mira handles intake, structured psychiatric assessment and documentation — so clinics see more clients without adding staff.
